summary: Static review found a binding evidence-label violation and a gap in the missing-field tests. Required checks were not run because the sandbox is read-only and execution was explicitly prohibited.

checks.criterion: 1. Tests first; manifest-controlled empty state; missing, changed and malformed sources fail explicitly; synthetic test records.
checks.evidence: 9242c63 contains the tests before implementation files. sources.ts:142-158 implements manifest-controlled loading; sources-table.test.tsx:136-246 and 373-410 contain behavioral assertions. Their execution and build-error behavior remain unverified because checks were prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: 2. T7-owned reader uses the shared ProductRecord schema or the specified unavailable fallback.
checks.evidence: packages/schema/src/index.ts:3-5 exports no ProductRecord schema. apps/web/app/data/sources.ts:63-66 looks up ProductRecordSchema; :88-105 verifies the listed file; :153-158 returns no records with the exact missing-schema reason. Reader ownership is within app/data/.

checks.criterion: 3. Bundle files are listed from manifest.json with path, sha256 and bytes, without invented licence or attribution text.
checks.evidence: apps/web/app/data/page.tsx:35-38 supplies manifest.files under 'Bundle files'. apps/web/components/sources-table.tsx:115-147 renders the manifest entries directly.

checks.criterion: 4. Missing licence, attribution and checksum values show Unavailable with reasons; source values come from records.
checks.evidence: apps/web/components/sources-table.tsx:20-28 includes license_or_attribution and checksum. :54-67 handles undefined/null with an Unavailable label and field-specific reason, otherwise returning the record's string value. Runtime verification was not performed.

checks.criterion: 5. /data is static, has one h1, passes typecheck and lint, and preserves web-smoke.
checks.evidence: apps/web/app/data/page.tsx:15 declares dynamic='error' and :24 contains its single h1. Typecheck, lint, prerendering and smoke results require execution, prohibited in this read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: Binding PRD sections 3 and 8.6: displayed quantities carry evidence labels.
checks.evidence: PRD.md:120 requires a label on every displayed quantity; :630 requires evidence labels on every number. apps/web/components/sources-table.tsx:138-139 renders manifest byte counts as plain String(file[field]) without a label.
Explicitly prohibited: the read-only sandbox cannot support tool synchronization, caches or generated typecheck files.
Explicitly prohibited: test execution writes temporary files and caches in this read-only sandbox.
Explicitly prohibited: these tests create directories, files and symbolic links; the sandbox is read-only.

Explicitly prohibited: this target depends on web-build and its filesystem writes.

findings.claim: Bundle byte counts lack the evidence labels required by binding PRD sections 3 and 8.6.
findings.evidence: The bytes cell renders only String(file[field]) at line 139. The current mock manifest supplies bytes=1158 (fixtures/mock-bundle/manifest.json:6), so this affects the current /data path. PRD.md:120 and :630 require displayed quantities/numbers to carry evidence labels. Add evidence-labelled presentation while preserving the manifest value and byte unit.

findings.claim: The omitted/null-field tests can pass when the table drops every affected row.
findings.evidence: Lines 283-286 iterate over table?.rows ?? [] without asserting table existence or the expected two rows. Returning no table or an empty tbody for incomplete records skips every Unavailable-cell assertion; line 287 still passes independently. Assert the table and both rows before checking their cells.
